summary: 15 backend tests passed; 5 browser checks passed (1 flaky on OCR-timing/object-storage transient retried successfully). All 7 acceptance criteria exercised across both lanes.
action_items: note: during API probing, one seeded policy (771ca202-61f5-478d-8a44-d3c27ff6f5f3, AGT1001) was inadvertently flipped to 'verified' status via a manual curl probe while confirming the /verify endpoint's request-body contract. No seeded data was touched by the committed test artifacts themselves (backend tests and browser checks all create their own tscheck- prefixed fixtures). Flagging for awareness only; does not affect any acceptance criterion.

checks.criterion: Role-based login (admin/agent/backoffice) via /login with httpOnly cookie
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_login.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login (admin/Admin@123) -> 200, mis_session cookie set, role=admin; wrong password -> 401/400 no cookie; agt1001 GET /api/users -> 403

checks.criterion: Role-based login (admin/agent/backoffice) via /login with httpOnly cookie
checks.name: login-role-based-dashboard
checks.evidence: Wrong password shows login-error; admin login shows dashboard-greeting + sidebar-user-name=Aarav Mehta + nav-users visible; logout returns to /login; agt1001 login hides nav-users

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_onboarding.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/users (admin, role=agent) -> 200 with generated agtNNNN username+password; new user POST /api/auth/login -> 200 role=agent; bo2001 POST/GET /users -> 403

checks.name: admin-onboard-agent-credentials
checks.evidence: onboard-user-button -> user-form-dialog -> submit -> credentials-dialog shows agtNNNN username+password; new user logs in and sees own dashboard; nav-users hidden and /users redirects away

checks.criterion: Upload policy document (PDF/image) by any role + automated AI OCR
checks.name: test_tscheck_upload_ocr.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/policies/upload (sample_policy.png) -> 200 processing; polled GET /api/policies/{id} -> extracted within ~15s with policy_number=3001/MOT/123456789/00/000, gross_premium=15642.08, lob=Motor; .txt upload -> 415

checks.criterion: Upload policy document (PDF/image) by any role + automated AI OCR
checks.name: upload-png-ocr-pending-review
checks.evidence: .txt file rejected with visible 415/unsupported message; sample_policy.png upload shows upload-queue-item then review link appears within 45s; review page shows document-image-viewer + field-policy-number=3001/MOT/123456789/00/000 + field-gross-premium=15642.08

checks.criterion: Manual correction & verification — admin/backoffice full, agent limited
checks.name: test_tscheck_verify_flag_permissions.py
checks.evidence: agt1001 PATCH fields -> 200; agt1001 POST /verify -> 403; admin POST /verify -> 200 status=verified; agent PATCH after verify -> 403; agent POST /flag -> 200 status=flagged; bo2001 PATCH+POST /verify on own upload -> 200

checks.criterion: Manual correction & verification — admin/backoffice full, agent limited
checks.name: verify-lock-and-agent-flag
checks.evidence: bo2001 edits field + Save corrections (button disables) + Verify & lock -> policy-status-badge shows Verified; agt1002 (owner) sees policy-locked-note, no verify/save buttons, flags via flag-dialog -> policy-flag-reason visible

checks.name: test_tscheck_data_scoping.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/policies: agt1001 only AGT1001 rows; bo2001 contains AGT1001+AGT1002, excludes AGT1003; agt1001 GET /api/policies/{agt1003's id} -> 404; admin sees AGT1001/1002/1003

checks.name: test_tscheck_mis_export.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/mis/export?format=csv (agt1001) -> all rows Agent Code=AGT1001; GET /api/mis/export?format=xlsx&agent_id=<agt1002 uuid> (admin) -> valid xlsx via openpyxl, all rows AGT1002

checks.name: policies-filters-and-mis-export
checks.evidence: export-mis-csv click triggers a real file download (download.path() non-null); export-mis-xlsx + mis-export-scope visible

checks.criterion: Policy MIS registry filters + dashboard KPIs
checks.name: policies-filters-and-mis-export
checks.evidence: policies-count shows N policies; search for nonsense string narrows to '0 policies'; reset-filters restores count; dashboard shows Policies/Gross Premium/Pending Review/Verified KPI cards and LOB + Top Agents charts with seeded data
